metadata.description: Watcher: quiet live bands above the Claude Code prompt for subagents, background runs and context/usage.

plugins.name: agent-watcher
plugins.description: Watcher: a band above the prompt and a panel showing running subagents with pixel Clawd crabs; hides 10 min after the last one finishes.

plugins.name: run-watcher
plugins.description: Watcher: background tasks Claude starts (API calls, LLM runs, experiments, tests...) with categories, tags and a glowing track; output read only when expanded.

plugins.name: context-watcher
plugins.description: Watcher: a card above the prompt with the model, a big context bar and 5-hour usage with pace while a prompt runs; hides 10 min after.
